summary: The root "Anth" describes land that is plain, soft, and fertile, producing abundant vegetation.
lane: أَنِيثٌ ذ : see مُؤَنَّثٌ . -b2- أَرْضٌ أَنِيثَةٌ , (AA, * IAar, T, S, M, K,) and , (ISh, T, M, K,) (tropical:) Plain, even, or soft, land, or ground, (ISh, IAar, T, M, K,) that produces many plants, or much herbage; (AA, T, M, K;) or that produces herbs, or leguminous plants, and is plain, even, or soft; (El-Kilábee, S;) or fitted for producing plants, or herbage; not rugged. (ISh, T, L.) And مَكَانٌ أَنِيثٌ A place in which the herbage grows quickly, and becomes abundant. (T, L.) And بَلَدٌ أَنِيثٌ (assumed tropical:) A country, or district, of which the soil is soft, and plain, or even. (IAar, M, L.) -b3- حَدِيدٌ أَنِيثٌ (tropical:) Female iron; that which is not what is termed ذَكَرٌ : (S, M, L, K:) soft iron. (T and K in art. انف .) And سَيْفٌ أَنِيثٌ (tropical:) A sword of female iron: (M, L:) or a sword that is not sharp, or cutting; a blunt sword: (T, M, * L:) and سَيْفٌ , and , (T, M, L, K,) mentioned by Lh, (T, L,) a blunt sword; (K;) as also : (TA:) or a sword of soft iron. (T, L.)

headwords.def: اَنڤثَ [ أَنُثَ , aor. اَنُثَ , inf. n. أَنَاثَةٌ and أُنُوثَةٌ , (see the former of these two ns. below,) It was, or became, female, feminine, or of the feminine gender. And hence, أَنُثَتْ , said of land ( أَرْض ), (tropical:) It was, or became, such as is termed أَنِيثَة . Hence also,] أَنُثَ , said of iron, (tropical:) It was, or became, soft. headwords.gloss: He made it; feminine; he attached to it

parts.t: to that which was syntactically dependent upon it, the sign of the feminine gender.
He acted gently in his affair:
he applied himself gently to his affair:
he acted effeminately in his affair.

headwords.def: أنّثهُ , inf. n. تَأْنِيثٌ , He made it (namely, a noun [&c.], S and Msb) feminine; (S, M, L, Msb;) he attached to it, or to that which was syntactically dependent upon it, the sign of the feminine gender. (Msb.) (assumed tropical:) He, or it, rendered him effeminate. (KL.) [See the pass. part. n., below.] أنّث لَهُ , inf. n. as above, (tropical:) He acted gently, [or effeminately ] towards him; as also له . (K, TA.) And أنّث فِى أَمْرِهِ , inf. n. as above, (T, A,) (tropical:) He acted gently in his affair: (A:) or he applied himself gently to his affair: (T:) and some say, فى امره , meaning he acted effeminately in his affair. (T, TA.)

headwords.def: مِئْنَاثٌ A woman who usually brings forth females: (S, M, K:) and a man who usually begets female children; for the measure مِفْعَالٌ applies equally to both sexes: (S:) the contr. epithet is مِذْكَارٌ . (T.) سَيْفٌ مُؤَنَّثٌ : see أَنِيثٌ . طِيبٌ مُؤَنَّثٌ (tropical:) Perfume that is used by women; such as خَلُوق and زَعْفَران , (Sh, T, L,) and what colours the clothes: (L:) ُكُورَةُ الطِّيبِ being such perfumes as have no colour; such as غَالِيَة and كَافُور and مِسْك and عُود and عَنْبَر and the like, which leave no mark.
